summary: Promote the source-neutral interpretation idea into a formal proposal: source-specific adapters produce a neutral USG handoff; downstream targets preserve evidence classes, nulls, identifiers, relationships and acceptance invariants; only contradiction of recorded descent premises should reopen upstream interpretation.
rationale: The proposal generalizes beyond Building 001 and is consistent with USG's software-neutral purpose. It adds useful structure not yet explicit in the current repository: descent premises, mapper preservation duties, explicit approximate-policy choices and target-independent read-back acceptance. However, the evidence base is still too narrow to modify the canonical stage model or protocol. v0.12 already covers export classification and sidecar manifests, so that portion is treated as duplicate/canonical support rather than a new rule.
provenance: Building 001 hand-sketch -> neutral JSON -> STL/Blender reconstruction
